🔥THE SECRET TO HANDLING KENYAN GEN Z🔥

The whole world has now heard about Kenyan Gen Z.
And if you have not.... please update your browser or step outside.
Because these kids? They are different.
Some people love them
Some people hate them
But either way....
Its undeniable that

There is something extremely special, extremely electric, and extremely explosive about them.

These are not your usual "tumezoea" youth.
These are our ancestors who have returned, YES! but with Wi-Fi, iPhones, and attitude 😎📱⚡

They are the first Gen Z in the entire world to enter Parliament.
They are the first to shake the entire government with hashtags,
And the first to organize a protest from Telegram while eating Smokie pasua on the street corner 😂🌭

They have done in days what our generation could not do in decades.
When they say “#RejectFinanceBill” even the government feels that tremor. 🌍

They organize protests online,
And then show up in their hundreds of thousands and thousands of thoudands;  some in Ubers, some in crocs, some holding placards made from manila paper and broken hearts 💔
And after protesting? They sit in a circle and eat KFC like true warriors 🍗🔥😂

And when one of their own falls 😢...
They wrap them in the Kenyan flag,
Lift them high,
And walk through teargas and bullets .. like legends rising in a movie we will never forget.
😭😭😭

They are so united, so bold, and so clever.
They have turned TikTok into truth,
Twitter into thunder,
And Telegram into Parliament.

They create apps.
They crowdfund funerals.
They raise awareness.
They cancel fake news.
They start NGOs by accident.
They go viral without trying.
They protest with memes and lyrics.
They record live streams while running away from police 😭📸

And guess what?
They do not want to go abroad to clean people’s homes.
They want to build their own homes right here.
They do not want handouts.
They want equity.
They want partnerships, ownership, and accountability.
They want to own their country and have fair systemz and they are doing it one digital revolution at a time 🔥

Now, as a founder, let me tell you what happened when I gave Gen Z more than jobs:
I gave them a seat at the table... and shares in the kitchen.
I have never looked back.
I work with them, not over them , and my whole life has changed.

Now here is the biggest secret 
And the best way
To handle Kenyan Gen Z
They are quitting jobs without notice
Because they can differenciate
Whether you are using them
Or building them
If your business is stuck, give Gen Z a stake.
Make them your partners.
Let them fly the plane.
Just sit back, sip your tea 🍵 and ask for results.
They will shock you (in a good way) 😅

And this is where blockchain comes in.
Because the only system powerful and transparent enough to hold Gen Z’s fire is blockchain 🔗🔥
No cheating. No lying. Just clear receipts and crypto confidence.

Here at Tzee Nation, we do not hire Gen Z to follow instructions.
We give them the tools to build the future.
We give them Tzee Tokens.
We give them real ownership.
We teach them mental health, financial literacy, and self-leadership.

We are not building another Silicon Valley.
We are building something better, louder, prouder..... and African.

💥KENYAN GEN Z ARE AMAZING!💥
If you are Gen Z and reading this...
Join us at Tzee Nation right now!
We have some coins for you
...and maybe some KFC too 😋🍗

MONSOON, TYPHOON DRAG RAINS ACROSS LUZON

Heavy rains continue to lash Luzon as PAGASA hoisted an orange rainfall warning over Zambales, Bataan, Batangas, and Cavite at 11 a.m. Thursday, July 24, due to the enhanced southwest monsoon and Typhoon #EmongPH.

Metro Manila, Rizal, Laguna, Quezon, Bulacan, Pampanga, and Tarlac remain under a yellow warning, with possible flooding in low-lying areas.
